Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing follow-up - GPU / throughput

Thanks for the call this morning, Marissa. Quick recap and a couple of clarifying Qs from our side: we liked the idea of reserved capacity for consistent latency.

1) Expected monthly token volume: ballpark 120M tokens/month initially, with a 6-12 month ramp to ~500M tokens/month if latency and cost look good.
2) Our target unit economics: we'd like to model at approximately $60-80 per 1M tokens as the target for total inference cost (including infra + Redwood margin).
3) Throughput: for peak trading hours we need sustained throughput ~12k tokens/sec and short spikes to ~25k tokens/sec. Typical request size 256 tokens.

On the GPU side: we're OK with either A100 80GB or H100; main ask is predictable throughput and the ability to scale to additional GPUs quickly.

Next steps for us: can you provide a dedicated sizing + pricing estimate (reserved pool options and unit $/1M tokens) for 4x H100, 8x A100, and a 12-GPU burst option? Also include any assumptions about batching and expected latency SLOs.

Jordan
Director of AI Platforms
Acme Corp

From: marcus_lin@redwood.com

Subject: Re: Dedicated capacity pricing follow-up - GPU / throughput (technical sizing)

Jordan / team — attaching a quick technical sizing summary in-line below, plus I uploaded the detailed worksheet to the shared drive (link in related_links). Assumptions: 256-token responses average, 70% single-shot, 30% streaming; model = Falcon-40B-ish equiv latency profile; batching enabled with 50ms aggregation window.

Option A — 4x H100 (reserved):
- Sustained throughput: ~10-14k tokens/sec (depends on batching and request distribution)
- Peak burst (with autoscale/burst pool): ~22-26k tokens/sec for short periods
- Latency SLO: median 160-220ms for 256-token responses with batching window=50ms
- Notes: H100 yields better per-token perf on recent LLMs, smaller reserved footprint.
\Option B — 8x A100 80GB:
- Sustained throughput: ~9-12k tokens/sec
- Peak burst: ~18-22k tokens/sec
- Latency SLO: median 200-300ms for 256-token responses
- Notes: A100 is reliable and more commonly available; slightly higher batching sensitivity.
\Option C — 8x A100 + 4x H100 burst (12 GPU burst enabled):
- Sustained baseline (A100 pool): ~9-12k tokens/sec
- Burst to 25-30k tokens/sec with H100s added for peaks
- Latency SLO: baseline ~220ms, burst median ~180ms (when H100s are active)
\Capacity considerations:
- If you expect 500M tokens/month steady-state, we recommend moving to a larger baseline (12+ GPUs) as that maps better to predictable unit costs.
- Estimated GPU utilization assumptions in model: 40-60% effective utilization after conservative KV cache and batching losses.
\I'll attach the detailed simulator and cost assumptions in the pricing worksheet. Happy to jump on a quick call to walk this through — suggest 30 minutes with engineering if you want live tuning.
\Marcus Lin
Staff Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com

Jordan — following up on schedule/procurement items. Based on the sizing Marcus proposed, here's a commercial sketch and timeline we can fast-follow into a formal quote: 

Commercial sketch (monthly reserved pricing ranges, US list):
- 4x H100 reserved pool: $120k - $160k / month; estimated unit $/1M tokens (at 120M tokens/mo) = $95-$125.
- 8x A100 reserved pool: $95k - $130k / month; estimated unit $/1M tokens = $80-$110.
- Baseline 8x A100 + 4x H100 burst (12 GPUs): $170k - $220k / month; estimated unit $/1M tokens = $65-$90 (improves with utilization and larger token volumes).
\Notes: these ranges reflect committed term discounts (12- or 36-month), expected utilization (40-60%), and include Redwood platform fees but exclude network egress and any custom enterprise add-ons (extended retention, premium SLAs). We can tighten these to single-line prices once you confirm desired term and expected average monthly tokens.
\Procurement timeline:
- Week 0: accept preliminary SOW / sign NDA if required.
- Week 1-2: Redwood prepares formal quote + SOW + initial PO template.
- Week 3-4: Procurement review / PO issuance.
- Week 5-8: Dedicated environment provisioned and validation (shorter if customer provides private infra network details early).
\Action items I can take: prepare a one-page pricing summary for your finance team this week, and a formal quote/SOW once you confirm the preferred baseline (4x H100, 8x A100, or 12 GPU burst). Please confirm which option you want us to prioritize.
